Leah Kim: Morning! Quick onboarding questions: 1) I enrolled in benefits but missed the commuter election  can I add it now? 2) My direct deposit status shows 'pending verification'  how long until active? 3) Do company holidays apply for new hires starting next week or prorated?
Omar (People Ops): Hey @Leah welcome aboard! Short answers: 1) Commuter (pre-tax) elections are editable for 30 days from your start date in the benefits portal under Flexible Spending -> Commuter. If the window closed, file a ticket and we'll check eligibility. 2) Payroll Bot posts micro-deposits within 48 hrs; confirm amounts in Payroll Portal -> Bank & Payment Methods to activate. If you used Plaid it's usually instant. 3) Company holidays are paid if you're on the payroll on the holiday date (no pro-rata). PTO accrual is prorated based on start date.
Payroll Bot: Payroll notice: Micro-deposits sent to account ending 6789 on 2026-04-04. Please confirm in Payroll Portal within 10 days.
Leah Kim: Thanks! I found the commuter tab and updated election. One follow-up  my offer mentioned a relocation reimbursement cap of $1200  do receipts go to Expensify or Concur?
Sam (Manager): @Leah we asked Recruiting to route relocations through Expensify/People Ops. Tag @Omar after you submit so we can approve quickly.
Omar (People Ops): Confirmed: submit receipts in Expensify under policy 'Relocation - People Ops' and include Offer ID (OFFER-8345). Relocation advances available if needed; file a ticket titled 'Relocation Advance: Leah Kim'. Typical processing 1-2 payroll cycles after approval.
Leah Kim: Perfect. Uploaded receipts and submitted the ticket. Appreciate the quick help! :thanks:
